summary: Toyota Auto Finance Receivables LLC filed an 8-K reporting the entry into an underwriting agreement for a securitization of auto loan receivables by Toyota Auto Receivables 2026-C Owner Trust. The trust will issue six classes of asset-backed notes totaling $1.9 billion, with closing expected July 21, 2026. This is a routine ABS shelf takedown, not a special situation. The filing describes a standard structured finance transaction with no change of control, strategic shift, or extraordinary corporate event. No deal terms such as price per share, premium, or break fee apply as this is an asset-backed note issuance.
